definitions.explanation: A medical facility specializing in dental care. In Japan, most dental practices are small private clinics rather than large hospital departments.

examples.japanese: {歯科医院|しかいいん}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I made an appointment at the dental clinic.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{新|あたら}しい{歯科医院|しかいいん}ができた。
examples.english: A new dental clinic opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}から{通|かよ}っている{歯科医院|しかいいん}が{来月|らいげつ}{閉院|へいいん}するらしい。
examples.english: The dental clinic I've been going to since childhood is apparently closing next month.

notes:
Composed of {歯科|しか} (dentistry) + {医院|いいん} (clinic). The standard term for a private dental practice in Japan. Japan has one of the highest densities of dental clinics in the world, with over 60,000 nationwide.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歯科医院|しかいいん}に{通|かよ}う: to visit a dental clinic regularly
- {歯科医院|しかいいん}を{予約|よやく}する: to make a dental appointment
- {歯科医院|しかいいん}で{治療|ちりょう}を{受|う}ける: to receive treatment at a dental clinic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {歯医者|はいしゃ}: dentist — the casual, everyday word; also used to refer to the clinic itself colloquially
- {歯科|しか}: dentistry — the field itself, or used as a prefix (e.g., {歯科|しか}{医師|いし} = dentist)
- {医院|いいん}: clinic — a general medical clinic; {歯科医院|しかいいん} specifies dental
